properties.statement: OBSERVED 2026-10-18 while writing phase 2's tests (reflow2 at b639be8 plus feat/reasoning-attached-to-the-structure-it-justifies, in-memory service through MCP). A Contributor who:owner was added, then add_decision {id, name, decision, rationale, status: "rejected", approver: "who:owner"}. The reply stored properties.status "proposed", is_error false, and said only loop_hint "loop: a Decision lands `proposed` — only the owner's word moves it (set_decision_status)". The same call without an approver is refused naming the rule. Expected: either the Decision lands rejected and signed (the one-call settle path accepted for `accepted`), or the call is refused saying which statuses it settles. Workaround used: add_decision, then set_decision_status {status: "rejected", approver, chose}. No cause is stated here: not yet walked with the root-cause skill. Precedent read first (search_design): fact:root-cause-add-decisions-lands-proposed-hint-recurred-on-the-one-call-settle-path-2026-09-29, a different symptom (the hint is wrong on a write that DID settle).
